name: ai-pipeline
description: 12-command AI development pipeline (/init, /plan-improve, /feature, /improve, /fix, /lesson, /remember, /questionnaire, /release, /resume, /validate, /deprecate) with frontier-round elicitation, a spec playback sign-off gate, living EARS requirements with traceability and a risk register, a numerical quant-verify gate with oracle taxonomy, harness-level enforcement hooks, a reality-validation loop, auto-critic at two gates, lessons-learned flywheel, Serena memory, and Playwright-MCP visual verification gate for frontend projects. Builds on Superpowers, Beads, Context7.
